title: Correct initial pressure
description: Essential: Student must state or derive p₁ = p₀ - Mg/S from force balance on piston when lifted.

title: Correct final pressure
description: Essential: Student must state or derive p₂ = p₀ + Mg/S from force balance after inversion.

title: Ideal gas law application
description: Important: Student must apply p/T = constant for the constant-volume heating process.

title: Correct ΔT expression
description: Essential: Student must derive ΔT = (2Mg/(p₀S - Mg))T₁ as the final answer.

title: Force balance reasoning
description: Important: Student must analyze forces on piston in both orientations to determine gas pressure.

title: Sign error in pressures
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly swaps signs in pressure expressions (e.g., p₁ = p₀ + Mg/S).

title: Volume condition recognition
description: Important: Student must recognize that returning to initial position implies constant volume.

title: Algebraic manipulation
description: Optional: Student shows clear algebraic steps from p₁/T₁ = p₂/(T₁+ΔT) to final ΔT expression.
